name: semantic-code-intelligence
description: Unified ontology-enhanced code intelligence system with MCP, LSP, and HTTP adapters

scripts.build:all: bun run build:lsp && bun run build:mcp-stdio && bun run build:mcp-http && bun run build:http && bun run build:cli
scripts.build:lsp: bun build ./src/servers/lsp.ts --target=bun --outdir=dist/lsp --format=esm --external tree-sitter --external tree-sitter-typescript --external tree-sitter-javascript --external tree-sitter-python --external pg --external bun:sqlite --external express --external cors
scripts.build:mcp-stdio: bun build ./src/servers/mcp.ts --target=bun --outdir=dist/mcp --format=esm --external tree-sitter --external tree-sitter-typescript --external tree-sitter-javascript --external tree-sitter-python --external pg --external bun:sqlite --external express --external cors
scripts.build:http: bun build ./src/servers/http.ts --target=bun --outdir=dist/http --format=esm --external tree-sitter --external tree-sitter-typescript --external tree-sitter-javascript --external tree-sitter-python --external pg --external bun:sqlite --external express --external cors
scripts.build:cli: bun build ./src/servers/cli.ts --target=bun --outdir=dist/cli --format=esm --external tree-sitter --external tree-sitter-typescript --external tree-sitter-javascript --external tree-sitter-python --external pg --external bun:sqlite --external express --external cors
scripts.build:mcp-http: bun build ./src/servers/mcp-http.ts --target=bun --outdir=dist/mcp-http --format=esm --external tree-sitter --external tree-sitter-typescript --external tree-sitter-javascript --external tree-sitter-python --external pg --external bun:sqlite --external express --external cors
scripts.alpha:mvp:test: bun test tests/alpha-mvp-tool-contract.test.ts tests/alpha-mvp-mcp-parity.test.ts tests/alpha-mvp-mcp-http-protocol.test.ts tests/alpha-mvp-mcp-stdio-protocol.test.ts tests/alpha-mvp-cli-parity.test.ts
scripts.alpha:mvp:check: bun run build:tsc && bun run alpha:mvp:test && mkdir -p .test-results && bun run scripts/dogfood-alpha-mvp.ts --json > .test-results/alpha-mvp-dogfood.json && bun run self:dogfood:cli && ./scripts/migration-hygiene.sh

author: tryingET
